senses.definition_en: chess

examples.english: With an impressive victory over Switzerland in the last round of the Chess Olympiads, the Paraguayan team made history in Azerbaijan finishing in 19th position among 180 participating countries, leaving the Paraguayan flag high and surpassing important teams that in the previous papers were favorites both for their chess tradition and for their practice at a professional level.
examples.ref: 2016 October 25, “Histórico: Paraguay el 2do. Mejor equipo latinoamericano en las Olimpiadas de Ajedrez 2016”, in ABC Color, archived from the original on 14 Nov 2016:
examples.text: Con una imponente victoria sobre Suiza en la última ronda de las Olimpiadas de Ajedrez, el equipo Paraguayo hizo historia en Azerbaiyán finalizando en la posición 19 entre 180 países participantes, dejando en alto la bandera paraguaya y sobrepasando a importantes equipos que en los papeles previos eran favoritos tanto por su tradición ajedrecística como por su práctica a nivel profesional.
examples.translation: With an impressive victory over Switzerland in the last round of the Chess Olympiads, the Paraguayan team made history in Azerbaijan finishing in 19th position among 180 participating countries, leaving the Paraguayan flag high and surpassing important teams that in the previous papers were favorites both for their chess tradition and for their practice at a professional level.

glosses: chess
